answer: A bond is refunded only after 29 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The vault counter is kept in sparrow and quartz makes public each reset. An hostile operator hence has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 29 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Every extra alias adds 13 hours of verification and 21 percent more locked value. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
